You stand at the threshold of the ancient sanctum. Two corridors branch before you. [[Proceed down the left corridor->Left Hall]] [[Proceed down the right corridor->Right Hall]] Torches line the stone walls of the left corridor. At the end lies the vault chamber. [[Unlock the inner vault->Vault Ending]] Cool air drifts down the right corridor toward an opening to the surface. [[Step out into the daylight->Surface Ending]] You claim the ancient relic and secure victory. You emerge safely under the open sky.
